name: Blade Fighter Viper
lore: Adaptation du Blade Fighter NECA moderne (2014), que le fabricant associe à Viper. Ce nom de variante appartient au catalogue du jeu ; il ne prouve pas un modèle cinématographique ni un châssis exclusif à Viper.

assets.label: Blade Fighter Viper — identité NECA 2014
assets.prompt: Use the supplied official NECA Blade Fighter modern 2014 SIDE PROFILE photograph as the exact design reference. Preserve the compact wide dark chassis, swept metallic warm bronze side wings, black dorsal fin with red stripe and subtle blue lightning paint pattern, twin cylindrical blue-black/red front engine pods, pointed bronze canopy nose with black teardrop insets, ribbed dark rear hardware, and the exceptionally LONG thin forward-pointing pair of openwork dark steel scimitar blades on a red under-nose attachment. Vehicle nose and long blades are toward the RIGHT in the reference. Preserve the ratio: extended blade region is nearly as long as the main vehicle body. Do not reinterpret it as a motorcycle or add handlebars, wheels, dragons or skulls. REMOVE the Predator pilot entirely: empty pilot cavity, no hands/legs/face or anatomy embedded. Draw a clean original painted GAME BITMAP adaptation, NOT a cutout photograph or reference page. Orthographic 2D side elevation with just enough visible width to distinguish the paired blade rails and side wing. Exactly TWO complete profiles stacked vertically: TOP faces RIGHT, BOTTOM faces LEFT. Same scale and baseline within their equal halves; conserve asymmetrical hardware correctly in the independently drawn opposite side. Every blade tip and rear projection remains within wide 10-percent empty margins. The aircraft has its canopy closed with no pilot. Pure flat MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no shadow, ground, smoke, text, packaging, logo or watermark. Do not copy the words Figure not included.
